verificationNarrative: Entity `a911ef71-799c-4240-ad13-8fabd3caeafa` implements its single printed instruction with `takeExtraTurn()`. C8 and RD-hv-7x4l.1-13 govern the existing turn machinery; RD-hv-umm2.112-1 records its controller, queue and resumption contract. The runtime uses the existing queue without changing turn, interpreter, view or persisted state bodies. Runtime source churn is 59 added and 1 deleted line.

The plain 216-line synthetic contract module adds 11 cases and zero test entrypoints or jsdom files. Observable coverage includes both controllers, resolution during the opponent's turn, last-in-first-out ordering, normal resumption, all eight phases with Dreamwell and Draw, the explicit round limit, real exhaustion and once-per-turn reset, duration boundaries, privacy, Prevent, reload, partial steps, late failure, wrong actors, stale/concurrent/duplicate input and resolution-prompt cancellation. The no-op, wrong-controller and wrong-order mutations fail 9, 3 and 1 cases respectively; the primitive source is restored exactly.

Final focused takeExtraTurn contracts pass all 11 cases. Final review passes 262 files and 3,182 cases, both typechecks, lint, import-cycle analysis and the new friction-record schema check; sequential Knip passes. The earlier successful focused run included the coverage gate. Weighted fuzz passes 300 games and 152,215 steps with zero failures; the entity is included 620 times and exercised 212 times. The full suite is reserved for release-stage validation because this change adds bounded primitive/event registrations and leaves cross-cutting bodies and configuration unchanged.

Node preflight and the browser sweep cover both sides and every eligible variant: 12 pass, 8 ineligible skips, zero failures. Every sweep browser report has an empty error buffer. The UUID's SHA-256 first byte is 106, outside the D21 sample below 26. Existing plain battle-log presentation introduces no prompt, status indicator or visual component. A separate desktop scenario exercises actual queue consumption and the extra turn through ordinary controls.

A grant emitted before an enclosing optional resolution prompt is visible in that step's pending display. The committed queue remains unchanged until the step completes. If a synthetic later instruction throws, the committed queue and RNG recover while the generic fold retains the previously published prefix and reports engine.error. This follows the existing fold publication contract, exercised here rather than claiming full publication rollback.

Failed checks and provisional observations remain in the structured measurement record with their actual exits. The initial unused-import review was terminated after its failed lint/type results; the final readonly fixture failure was corrected by constructing a synthetic state with explicit configuration. No passing evidence is claimed for either failure. Final timing records include all research, parent coordination, waits and verification through the preparation immediately before commit.

The accepted normal-battle desktop workflow plays physical instance `i61` with the entity UUID through the hand, records its grant, and passes normal phase controls into extra player Day. Turn number rises from 1 to 2, player turn count rises to 2, round stays 1 and the queue empties. Publications include the extra turn start, a real Dreamwell draw and a card draw. The phase control is 122.6875 × 42 CSS pixels at (1117.8125, 597), inside 1440 × 900 with a valid centre hit. `extra-turn-day-desktop.png` is 1440 × 900 and was visually inspected. The game `uoxeqk` exported 57 persisted JSONL records, including its real play intent and exactly one `engine.extraTurn` record for `i61`, before browser close. All error buffers are empty.

The initial geometry failure and the empty-Dreamwell card-lab attempt retain their complete reports and exported game logs. The accepted run uses the existing normal battle scene, normal Battle Start and debug-panel UI intents to add the UUID and supply its play energy. The lab's empty Dreamwell is a fixture limitation rather than evidence that an actual extra turn omits its draw. All three attempts' actual scopes and timings remain in JSON; only the final passing workflow is acceptance evidence.

All recorded command PIDs and four owned server groups are absent, port 5178 is free, and CLI browser/provider cleanup settled. Every final source hash matches its frozen manifest. No runtime source changed during fuzz, preflight, sweep or workflow QA.
